$comment: Schumacher (wallcoverings and fabrics) is behind an AWS WAF JavaScript challenge: plain HTTP and AvalAI's page fetch return an empty page, and headless Chrome passes the challenge but does not render the product. So the site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search. The shop is never contacted; values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and ai_fetch http: EMPTY_PAGE; browser: rendered without the product name, so not used; ai_fetch browser: EMPTY_PAGE; web_search: success (3 specs, 558+107 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
